title: The House That Refuses Noon
creative_premise: A fixed impossible house whose routes appear and disappear only as the visitor moves an artificial sun.

provenance.observed: Independent identity notes prefer dynamic, spatial, surprising interfaces with working interactions.
provenance.inferred: Illumination can act as architecture without requiring narrative exposition or persistent identity.
provenance.experiment: Test whether route legibility alone can make fixed geometry feel mutable.
provenance.current_decision: Keep the work self-contained, local, non-extractive, reversible, accessible, and separate from Mirror Cartographer grammar.

performed: GitHub contents API accepted all additive source writes.
Source contract was committed for network silence, no persistence, accessibility, pointer and keyboard input, bounded rendering, teardown, and guarded animation scheduling.
